{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter out refunded orders — they are not conversions
# Only completed orders count toward conversion rate
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rates = df_completed.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rates.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rates.max()

print("Conversion rates by segment:")
print(conversion_rates)
print(f"\nHighest conversion rate: {best_segment} with {best_rate:.4f}")"}
